subject: done S19 (review19 rework)
body:
S19 rework (review19) is on claude/naadi-shared: 752ef76, f699193, cafcaba, 777cd9c (all S19-titled; earlier S19: 4f28394, 25999b0..cd9817e, a6c003b).
CI: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44081098694 (run 226 for 777cd9c, queued at post time). Local evidence below.

## Review19, defect by defect
1. Seed respects admin edits. Migration 0036 adds `admin_edited_at` to chapters, questions and media_assets. Trigger `naadi_mark_admin_edit` sets it on every non-seed insert, and on every non-seed update that changes content; stats/review/updated_at are ignored. The importer marks its own transactions (GUC `naadi.seed`) and skips marked rows unless `--force`. `section_media.origin` ('seed'|'admin'): the seed replaces or deletes only seed placements, never admin attachments. New db test: test_admin_edits_and_attachments_survive_a_seed_unless_forced.
2–3. Publish gates allow storable licences only. `stored_copy_refusal` refuses private, link-only, ND, NC (unless sources_policy.owner_confirms_noncommercial, default false), no-copy and no-modify sources for host/page/text uses. YouTube stays embed-only. StatPearls, usmle-official-samples and GeneReviews can never publish stored content. Table-driven test over every sources.yaml id (tests/admin/test_licence_sources.py), plus db test test_only_storable_licences_publish_text_or_files. The web source pickers only offer sources usable for that use.
4. Single approval path: seg15b removed its route and page (be208fe). The generated_media queue in S19 is the only approve/reject.
5. Authoring e2e never skips on the local stack. It sets the e2e_admin_probe flag itself and restores feature_flags in `finally` (asserted equal to before).
6. Server HTML allowlist (admin/html_clean.py) mirrors SafeHtml (a test compares the lists).
7. Uploads are staged in content-private/staging/figures (0036 lets that bucket take sanitised SVG). Approve moves the file to content-public; reject moves it back.
8. app_config audit is written in the same transaction as the save (put on_saved hook), for update and revert.
9–10. Editor fixes (nested forms, block insert, search fields).
11. Raster bound: header pixel check of 40 MP, DecompressionBombWarning raised as an error, Pillow globals untouched.
Also found by the e2e: signed URLs from a direct storage-api host are now rebased onto the gateway origin, which the CSP img-src lists (777cd9c, plus a unit test).

## Local evidence (at 777cd9c, rebased on shared)
- integrate gate: lint, typecheck, vitest (shared 133, ink 75, web 737), pytest unit 1755 passed / 1 skipped.
- db (fresh separate stack, re-migrated 0034→0036): test_admin_api, test_seed, test_storage_policies, test_rls_coverage: 52 passed; test_schema_doc + test_migrate: 9 passed. Alembic single head 0036. Contracts regenerated, no drift.
- e2e admin.spec.ts, --retries=0, twice: run 1 9 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed; run 2 the same. Projects: webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440. The 3 skips are the authoring flow, which by design runs in one project only (webkit-ipad-portrait), where it passed both times with zero console errors. Before the CSP fix it failed in both runs on CSP console errors only.
- Screenshots: test-results/screens/19/ (56 files, every admin area at iPad portrait, iPad landscape, phone and laptop).

## Not S19's (unchanged)
The seed live_check `sources` count (S20 user uploads); the qbank answer-column guard in ingest/placements/builtin.py (S15).
